Use Claude Code to get the agent working, then deploy it in your favorite cloud.

(rUv): Agentic Engineering, Open Source AI, and Contrastive Intelligence

TL;DR: Reuven Cohen, known as rUv and ruvnet, is an AI engineer and Founder and Chief AI Officer of Cognitum One. The ruvnet stack is an open source AI ecosystem for spatial sensing, vector and graph memory, agent orchestration, portable execution, and evaluated improvement, built around RuView, RuVector, Ruflo, RVF (RuVector Format), RVM, and MetaHarness.

  • Ruflo: AI agent orchestration.
  • RuVector: Vector search and agent memory.
  • RuView: WiFi spatial sensing.
  • Cognitum One: Commercial deployment and governance.
  • ruOS: Enterprise agent computers.

rUv's contrastive AI approach

Our contrastive AI approach combines similarity learning with structural checks: bring related observations together, separate mismatches, measure drift, and gate updates against explicit constraints. RuVector supplies the memory and graph substrate; agent harnesses use that context to guide and evaluate work. Performance and reliability depend on the workload and validation.

Explore the detailed animated contrastive AI slideshow: six scenes covering similarity, memory graphs, drift, and governed updates.

rUv's work in agentic engineering

Reuven Cohen's early agentic engineering work spans AI tools and plugins in 2023, SPARC development workflows, and the Claude Flow lineage that became Ruflo. That work evolved into coordinated swarms, adaptive memory, portable runtimes, and governed improvement through RuVector, RVF, RVM, and MetaHarness. Dated evidence and scoped pioneering claims document specific contributions alongside earlier related work.

Connect your agents: federation, skills, command line interface (CLI) and Model Context Protocol (MCP)

Your team. Your agents. One federation. Coordinate at x.ruv.io · RuFlo federation dashboard

MCP: ChatGPT uses https://x.ruv.io/chatgpt/mcp; Claude and service clients use https://x.ruv.io/mcp. Authorize when prompted. Setup & details.

Start with the RuV Stack: Install skills + marketplace · CLI / MCP guide · MetaHarness Claude Code: /plugin marketplace add ruvnet/ruvnet, then /plugin install ruvnet@ruvnet. Reviewed changes: node plugins/ruvnet/bin/ruvnet.mjs changes 5 --kind security · snapshot-bound exact evidence with auditable filters and continuation cursors · Harness evidence

This ecosystem is published through one developer account. Repositories can include community contributions, automation, generated artifacts, and imported history. The evidence files keep those categories separate.

Cognitum One · Constellation · Core systems · Get started · Reach · What is new · Evidence

Explore the constellation

One ecosystem, many ways in. Start with the problem you want to solve. Follow the constellation from observations to memory, coordinated work, portable execution, and evaluated outcomes.

APx measures agent productivity through Agentic Power (AP), the ratio of accepted reference human work hours to complete elapsed hours; APx is its base 2 logarithm. rvCSI works with Channel State Information (CSI), measurements of how wireless signals propagate through a channel.

The connections describe complementary roles. Each project has its own interfaces, maturity, and evidence; this is a conceptual map, not a claim that every system is already integrated.

What is Cognitum One?

Cognitum One brings the open source ruvnet stack into enterprise hardware, software, deployment services, and governance systems. ruvnet is the public development ecosystem for experiments, reusable libraries, and community contributions; Cognitum One builds supported, sovereign deployments on that foundation.

The platform spans public cloud, customer infrastructure, and the low power edge. Private deployments can operate without external cloud services when the required models, dependencies, and integrations are available locally.

How do System 0, System 1, and System 2 fit together?

In this ecosystem, System 0, System 1, and System 2 describe complementary architectural roles: sensing and response, memory and retrieval, and reasoning and orchestration. These labels are an organizing model, not a universal AI standard or a claim of human cognition.

System Role Core technologies
System 0: Sense & Respond Observe the physical environment and act locally Cognitum Seed edge hardware, a WebAssembly (WASM) runtime, on device vector storage, and Cognitum RuView WiFi Channel State Information (CSI) sensing
System 1: Learn & Remember Ground work in local data and retain context RuVector memory and retrieval, with development tools for private data grounding
System 2: Reason & Orchestrate Coordinate specialized agents and evaluate their work Ruflo, MetaHarness, and enterprise deployment services

ruOS provides the agentic desktop and execution environment connecting these capabilities to applications, files, and terminals.

What is ruOS?

Cognitum One announced ruOS on October 6, 2026. Teams of agents work inside managed Linux environments on infrastructure the customer controls, with persistent RuVector context, Ruflo coordination, and MetaHarness evaluation. Administrators define access, approval requirements, and action policies.

ruOS ships as a standard .deb package and supports local and virtual deployments. Restricted network and air gapped operation requires locally available models and dependencies. Explore ruOS · Public ruOS repository · Cognitum repositories

Leadership and advisors

Reuven “rUv” Cohen is Founder and Chief AI Officer; D. Christopher Keil is Founding CEO. Founding advisors and investors include Mark B. Templeton, former CEO of Citrix; Dr. Greg Lavender, former CTO of Intel; and John McKinley, former President of AOL Technologies.

Strategic advisors include Adrian Cockcroft, Sean Patterson, Tom Lounibos, Jason La Barbera, Stuart Kerr, and Mark Allen, MD, bringing experience across cloud architecture, product, capital, AI workforce adoption, growth, and healthcare. Meet the team · Advisory team announcement

October 2026 update

September was about connecting the parts. An agent needs somewhere to work, memory it can carry forward, and a way to show what happened. The work increasingly lives in those connections: Ruflo inside the coding session, RVF between sessions, RuVector behind the memory, and MetaHarness around the decision to keep a change.

Ruflo 3.50.0 brings Mods into that loop: prompt routing, tool checks, edit learning, cost controls, and a live swarm pane. The published release keeps Mods opt in and preserves classic hooks as the fallback. Later main commits add default installation and marketplace repair. The release and the moving branch are different evidence points.

RVF gives that continuity a concrete form. Memory, metadata, model payloads, and provenance can travel together in a file that a receiver can inspect. RVForge adds authoring, validation, and target staging. The useful boundary is simple: carrying a capability does not grant permission to execute it.

The six new public repositories extend the same idea. APx measures accepted work against a human reference. rGi keeps an agent loop durable across restarts. rultra brings governed adaptation to a Pi sensor box. MCP Studio makes the tools accessible through an application. ruPet and Agents of the Dawm explore a more human interface to the work, with the latter still a design proposal.

The direction is continuous software with an accountable history. More useful work, less repeated setup, and evidence that survives the session that produced it.

Full proof record · Commit and package receipts · October provenance delta

RVF: memory that travels with its evidence

RVF is RuVector Format. It packages segmented vector memory, metadata, model and compute payloads, lineage, and witness records. The aim is to carry useful state from a browser to a local runtime or a governed service without rebuilding the context at every step.

Piece Responsibility Evidence
RVF format and software development kit (SDK) Read, write, inspect and query portable memory SDK 0.3.4, published July 28
Wire contract Preserve exact segment and manifest bytes across readers Golden byte tests
Witness evidence Bind recorded actions, outcomes, costs and policy results; detect tampering Witness integration tests
RVForge Author, validate and stage a canonical RVF for target platforms RVForge 0.2.0, published August 5
Ruflo integration Portable agent memory and session persistence workflows RVF plugin contract

An artifact checksum proves which bytes were examined. A valid signature binds those bytes to a key. Neither proves that the recorded observation is true, that an experiment generalizes, or that execution is authorized. Verification needs a trusted key, an explicit policy, and evidence for the actual workload.

RVForge's current local build produces staged bundles. Native installer assembly, platform signing, and runtime validation are separate steps. Backend support varies across RVF native and WASM implementations. Ruflo's session encryption is opt in and does not automatically encrypt exported RVF bytes. These limits are part of the published contracts.

How the stack fits together

RuView, rvCSI, and RuField perceive. Ruflo coordinates. RuVector and AgenticOW remember. RVF carries state and evidence. RVForge stages it. RVM controls execution. MetaHarness evaluates change. Autogenous governs adaptation. APx measures useful work.

Sensing governance WiFi Veil, RuCelium Research sensing boundaries and represent provenance aware environmental observations

Learning memory RuVector, AgentDB, AgenticOW Store vector, graph, temporal, episodic, and branchable memory
Portable execution and transfer RVF, RVForge, rvQR, RVM Package and verify agentic applications, stage target bundles, transfer them optically in alpha, and execute them under capability controls

The rUv approach to intellectual property

Build in public. Publish working code, dated evidence, and reproducible results. Credit the foundational research and distinguish original contributions from integration and implementation. The prior art dossier records lineage and scoped novelty claims; each repository's license governs reuse.

Cognitum One builds commercial value through enterprise integration, hardware, governance, support, and deployment expertise. Public provenance documents contributions; it does not by itself establish patent rights or exclusive ownership.

Evidence and provenance

Evidence Purpose

Machine readable metrics Current counts, windows, caveats, and source links
GitHub snapshot Account, flagship, and recent repository traction from the public API

npm search exclusions Published maintained packages omitted from npm maintainer search

Claims policy Evidence rules for lineage, public traction, verified usage, and novelty

Repository lineage, public availability, feature evidence, public traction, verified usage, and novelty are distinct claims. A root commit anchors current history. It does not prove that every current feature existed at that date. Download events, clone events, stars, followers, and users are also kept distinct.
